pixel_counts={}
for camera in cameras['views']:
    view=camera['name']; buffer=buffers[view]
    owners=buffer['owners']; color=buffer['color'].astype(np.int32)
    marked=np.zeros(owners.shape,dtype=bool)
    horizontal=(owners[:,:-1]!=owners[:,1:]) & (np.sum((color[:,:-1]-color[:,1:])**2,axis=2)>=576)
    vertical=(owners[:-1,:]!=owners[1:,:]) & (np.sum((color[:-1,:]-color[1:,:])**2,axis=2)>=576)
    marked[:,:-1]|=horizontal; marked[:,1:]|=horizontal
    marked[:-1,:]|=vertical; marked[1:,:]|=vertical
    for index in panels:
        target=owners==index
        pixel_counts[(view,index)]=(int(np.count_nonzero(target)),int(np.count_nonzero(target&marked)))
print({geometry['objects'][index]['name']:{camera['name']:{'surface_pixels':pixel_counts[(camera['name'],index)][0],'boundary_pixels':pixel_counts[(camera['name'],index)][1],'complete':not checks[(camera['name'],index)]['blockers']} for camera in cameras['views']} for index in panels})
